attempts.summary: Configured the previously-unaddressed private links (node1 eth1↔node2 enp8s0 at 10.10.12.0/24, node1 eth2↔node3 enp8s0 at 10.10.13.0/24) with static IPs and specific routes so node2/node3 route through node1, verified 3-hop TTL routing, then applied a VyOS qos policy shaper (1mbit bandwidth/ceiling) on node1's eth2 egress (the node3-facing link) so only node2→node3 traffic is capped, while node3→node2 remains unrestricted. Verified with iperf3: baseline ~20 Gbps both directions before shaping; after shaping node2→node3 ≈0.84-0.92 Mbit/s, node3→node2 stayed at ~1.5 Gbps (unrestricted). All three nodes were then restarted one at a time (native reboot), boot_id changes confirmed genuine restarts, and post-reboot checks confirmed interface addressing, routing, IP forwarding, the htb/qos shaper, and the 1 Mbit/s cap on node2→node3 all persisted.
